voci.titolo: After tech-stock rout, October jobs report could bring relief — or more pain
voci.riassunto: After a tech-led meltdown in the stock market, the October jobs report on Friday morning could bring investors some encouraging news — or add to their misery.

voci.titolo: Argentina Bonds Drop as Market Flags Intervention in Peso Debt
voci.riassunto: Argentina’s sovereign peso bonds fell Thursday after a surge in trading and prices the day before raised speculation that the government was intervening to push down borrowing costs ahead of key Treasury auctions.

voci.titolo: Voters say the economy drove them to the polls — and blame Trump for their troubles
voci.riassunto: Participants in the CNBC Voter Poll ranked the economy the most important issue facing the country, ahead of topics tied to democracy and immigration.

voci.titolo: Bank of England hikes interest rate for the first time since Iran war, warns inflation will near 5%
voci.riassunto: One policymaker voted to raise the bank's key interest rate to 4.25%.

voci.titolo: Treasuries Soar as Tech-Stock Selloff Stokes Haven Demand
voci.riassunto: Treasuries surged as the Democratic sweep in this week’s US midterm elections sparked a selloff in shares of large US technology companies that stoked demand for havens.

voci.titolo: SpaceX Default Risk Hits Record High in Tech-Driven Credit Slump
voci.riassunto: SpaceX and CoreWeave Inc. were among the biggest casualties in a broad-based credit slump Thursday, as renewed fears that a Democrat sweep will bring tighter regulation on the artificial intelligence industry reverberated through markets.

voci.titolo: Here's what the Democratic election rout could mean for the U.S. economy
voci.riassunto: The biggest forces shaping the economy aren't going to change just because the party in power did.

voci.titolo: Hedge Fund Adviser LB Macro Sees US Midterms Boosting Dollar
voci.riassunto: Dollar bears may be misinterpreting the impact of US President Donald Trump’s setback in the midterm elections, according to a former head of strategy at Brevan Howard Asset Management.

voci.titolo: Analysis: The Democrats have one chance to extract concessions from Trump. Markets will hate it
voci.riassunto: The next debt-ceiling confrontation could reverse Washington's traditional political roles, raising the possibility of spending concessions, market volatility and a damaging default.

voci.titolo: Private companies added 86,000 jobs in October, slightly higher than expected, ADP says
voci.riassunto: Private-sector job growth held steady in October, with gains spread across sectors

voci.titolo: Euro zone inflation hits 4% for first time in three years as interest rate hike looms
voci.riassunto: It was driven by energy inflation, which surged above 20% in October.

voci.titolo: Job openings posted big September gain in positive sign for labor market ahead of payrolls report
voci.riassunto: The BLS reported job openings at 7.52 million, up 333,000 from August and well above the Dow Jones consensus outlook for 7.15 million

voci.titolo: Australia hikes rates to 18-year high to fight inflation
voci.riassunto: The Reserve Bank of Australia's decision was in line with expectations from economists polled by Reuters, and marked its fifth rate increase this year.

voci.titolo: South Korea targets 'world's highest performance' sovereign AI model in record new budget
voci.riassunto: The 2027 budget will rise 12.8% to 820.9 trillion won, and will include a 21.3 trillion won investment into semiconductors, physical AI and AI data centers.

voci.titolo: Euro zone economy slows to 0.4% growth in Q3 as crisis-hit France contracts
voci.riassunto: The euro zone showed surprising resilience, but weak productivity, industrial competitiveness challenges and demographic pressures remain, analysts said.
